result.description:
Are you a dedicated General Practitioner looking for a long-term role in a thriving community practice? An established medical center in a growing Victorian community, located just a 50-minute drive from Melbourne's CBD, is seeking a  full-time GP  to join its dynamic team. This is a rare opportunity to inherit a large and loyal patient base from a retiring doctor, ensuring a busy and fulfilling caseload from day one. 

  A Supportive and Modern Environment  

 This practice is committed to providing a top-tier environment for its clinicians. The facility features twelve modern consultation rooms, a three-bed treatment room, and a separate procedure room. The incoming GP will be part of a collegial team of nine GPs and will be fully supported by multiple nursing staff for treatment room and chronic disease management (CDM) duties, allowing you to focus on your clinical work. The on-site allied health services, which include physiotherapy, psychology, podiatry, and a dietician, provide an integrated and collaborative approach to patient care. 

  Professional Growth and Lifestyle  

 This role offers exceptional clinical autonomy, allowing you to shape your practice and pursue your professional interests. The clinic offers flexible working arrangements to ensure a healthy work-life balance and provides ample support for continuous professional development (CPD), including opportunities to become a supervisor for GP registrars. The location provides the perfect blend of a relaxed rural lifestyle with the convenience of city access. With its picturesque landscapes, sprawling parks, and local markets, this community is an ideal place to live and work, offering a serene escape from the hustle and bustle of city life.   Apply Now
